clue.text: Characters in a treetop in trouble — one has song and dance

indicators.note: letters in trouble are in a mess, so the phrase a treetop is rearranged

explanation.surface: Someone stuck up a tree causes a song and dance about it.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Characters in' tells you to work with the letters of 'a treetop'; 'in trouble' rearranges them.
explanation.definitionFit: A light opera combines singing with dancing and spoken scenes, so it is a show with song and dance.

clue.text: Tree, very big, that is hanging over river

indicators.note: in a down clue, the first pieces sit above the last one, hanging over it

parts.note: OS is the clothing abbreviation for outsize
IE is the abbreviation of id est, that is
R is the map abbreviation for river

explanation.surface: A huge tree leans out over a river.
explanation.definitionFit: A willow whose pliant twigs are used in basketry is a kind of tree.

clue.text: Food often eaten on Sun. that could be cooked before Sat.

indicators.note: cooked suggests the letters are fiddled, so before Sat is rearranged

explanation.surface: The Sunday joint could be prepared on Friday.
explanation.walkthrough: Sun. and Sat. are the abbreviations for Sunday and Saturday; a roast joint is the traditional British Sunday lunch.
explanation.definitionFit: Roast joint of beef is the classic British Sunday lunch dish.

clue.text: Number terribly rude unfortunately unable to be sacked?

parts.note: ten is a number

indicators.note: terribly signals the letters of rude are badly arranged

explanation.surface: A number of very rude people unfortunately cannot be fired.
explanation.walkthrough: 'unfortunately' only colours the surface, adding to the sense of bad luck; the anagram signal is 'terribly'.
explanation.definitionFit: An academic holding a permanent post has job security and cannot easily be dismissed.

clue.text: One would presumably never forget being in the Serengeti

definitions.text: One would presumably never forget being in the Serengeti

parts.words: One would presumably never forget being in the Serengeti
parts.note: proverbially a certain large animal never forgets, and this one's kind roams the Tanzanian plains

explanation.definitionFit: The big tusked animal of Tanzania's plains is proverbially said to have a perfect memory.

clue.text: What sounds like bivalve's bodily part

indicators.note: the word is chosen for how it is said, matching a shellfish name

parts.note: a mussel is a bivalve shellfish

explanation.surface: Asking what body part a shellfish has.
explanation.definitionFit: Tissue that contracts to move the body is a part of the body.

clue.text: Absent maiden is sitting on grass

indicators.note: in a down clue the first pieces sit on top of the last

parts.note: M is the cricket abbreviation for a maiden over
to grass is to inform, to sing to the police

explanation.surface: A young woman is absent, sitting on the lawn.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone missing is not present, which is what absent means.

clue.text: Very little money? Artist needs pounds — that's key

parts.note: a cent is a tiny sum of money
RA is a Royal Academician, an artist
L is the abbreviation for pounds sterling, from libra

explanation.surface: A poor artist needs money, which is the crucial thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Something key is of chief importance, at the core of things.

clue.text: Alley gent done out in refined style

indicators.note: done out suggests redecorated, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: A man in an alley is smartly dressed.
explanation.definitionFit: Acting with grace and polish means doing it with refinement.

clue.text: Pub around five — excellent or ineffective?

indicators.note: the pub word goes around the other pieces

parts.note: an inn is a pub
V is the Roman numeral five
A1 means first-class, written AI

explanation.surface: Asking whether a pub session around five o'clock is a great idea or a waste.
explanation.definitionFit: An idiom for fruitless effort: doing something to no avail is ineffective.

clue.text: Answer from silly person, see, falling short

indicators.note: silly signals the letters are muddled up
the word see is cut short by losing its last letter

explanation.surface: A foolish person gives a reply that falls short.
explanation.walkthrough: 'falling short' turns SEE into SE; 'silly' then rearranges PERSON with SE.
explanation.definitionFit: A reply is an answer given in return.

clue.text: The man to be brought in by bishop, one about to give empty talk

indicators.note: the bishop's letters surround the other pieces

parts.note: RR is Right Reverend, a bishop's title
he is the man
I is the Roman numeral one
C is circa, about

explanation.surface: A man is ushered in by a bishop to speak hollow words.
explanation.definitionFit: Bombastic, insincere language is talk empty of real meaning.

clue.text: Part of Europe like very cold part of Asia, avoiding the extremes

indicators.note: the first and last letters of the word are dropped

parts.words: like very cold part of Asia
parts.note: Siberian describes something of that frozen region

explanation.surface: A European region compared to frozen Siberia, minus its extremes of weather.
explanation.definitionFit: The peninsula holding Spain and Portugal is a region of Europe.

clue.text: Divine figure shown by model, one person at university

parts.note: to pose is to model
I is the Roman numeral one
a don is a university teacher

explanation.surface: A model and an academic display a god-like figure.
explanation.definitionFit: The Greek god of the sea is a divine figure.

clue.text: Wolves getting on — part of the drive for promotion?

definitions.text: part of the drive for promotion?

parts.note: wolves hunt in a pack
getting on means growing old, aging

explanation.surface: Wolverhampton Wanderers, ageing, push for promotion up the league.
explanation.walkthrough: Wolves is the nickname of a football club, but here it is plain animals; promotion is marketing, not football.
explanation.definitionFit: Product wrapping is part of a marketing push to promote sales.

clue.text: After end of training I am allowed a tool

indicators.note: the remaining pieces come after the first one
the last letter of training is taken

parts.note: I'm contracts I am
let means allowed

explanation.surface: Having finished training, I may have a tool.
explanation.definitionFit: A small boring tool with a screw tip is a hand tool.

clue.text: What could make him modest is a type of Christian outlook

indicators.note: the clue asks what the letters could be made into, so him modest is rearranged

explanation.surface: Religion that might make a man humble.
explanation.definitionFit: A Protestant tradition founded by John Wesley is a form of Christian belief.

clue.text: Skills required to get something afloat in the Civil Service

indicators.note: the floating object goes inside the abbreviation

parts.note: a raft floats

explanation.surface: Civil servants need skills to keep things afloat.
explanation.definitionFit: Trades or skilled arts are skills.

clue.text: A cricket club employer is one to blame others

parts.note: a user employs something

explanation.surface: A cricket club boss blames everyone else.
explanation.definitionFit: Someone who charges others with wrongdoing points the finger of blame.

clue.text: Quiet girl on river

parts.note: sh is a call for quiet
Ann is a girl's name

explanation.surface: A shy girl by a river.
explanation.definitionFit: Ireland's longest waterway is a river.

clue.text: Gushy stuff by right-wing politician in small room?

parts.note: lava gushes from a volcano
a Tory is a member of the UK Conservative Party

explanation.surface: Emotional outpourings by a Conservative in a little room.
explanation.walkthrough: 'small room' is a euphemism for a toilet.
explanation.definitionFit: The smallest room is a British euphemism for the toilet.

clue.text: French wine — drinking it before noon can provide what your body needs

indicators.note: the wine word takes in the other pieces

parts.note: vin is French for wine
am means ante meridiem, before noon

explanation.surface: A morning glass of French wine supplies what the body needs.
explanation.definitionFit: Essential organic nutrients are things the body must take in.

clue.text: A right place for the miraculous mysteries

parts.note: Cana is where Jesus turned water into wine

explanation.surface: A place where wonders happen holds mysteries.
explanation.definitionFit: Secret knowledge known only to initiates is a set of mysteries.

clue.text: Drug dens in underground caverns

parts.note: pot is cannabis
holes are dens or hideouts

explanation.surface: Drug dens set up in caves.
explanation.definitionFit: Deep vertical caves eroded in limestone are underground caverns.

clue.text: Support good person on tedious course?

parts.note: ST is a saint, a good person
a rut is a boring routine

explanation.surface: Backing a decent person stuck in a dull routine.
explanation.definitionFit: A brace bearing weight is a support.

clue.text: What threat of ghosts may bring when one is in weird mansion

definitions.text: What threat of ghosts may bring

indicators.note: the single letter sits inside the rearranged word
weird signals the letters of mansion are scrambled

parts.note: I is the Roman numeral one

explanation.surface: Fear of ghosts keeps you awake in a spooky mansion.
explanation.definitionFit: Inability to sleep is what fear of spooks at night could cause.

clue.text: Poster showing Norman?

explanation.definitionFit: One who sends letters is a poster; and Norman the American writer bore this surname.

clue.text: Good forest that may have a lot growing in it

definitions.text: that may have a lot growing in it

parts.note: Arden is the forest in As You Like It

explanation.surface: A fine forest might have plenty growing in it.
explanation.definitionFit: A plot of cultivated land has plants growing in it.

clue.text: Canon houses soldiers in accommodation

indicators.note: the first word holds the second inside it

parts.note: a canon is a principle, a tenet
men are soldiers

explanation.surface: A churchman puts up troops in his lodgings.
explanation.definitionFit: A block of flats provides accommodation.
